Architecture & Overview

Ultra-minimalist focus timer and task engine designed for deep work sessions.

# Focus Flow Focus Flow is built for engineers and creators who need uninterrupted concentration blocks. ## Core Features - **Adaptive Pomodoro Cycles**: Automatically tailors break times based on focus history. - **System-level DND Sync**: Toggles OS focus modes across phone and desktop simultaneously. - **Git Commit Sync**: Optionally logs your focused time blocks straight to your daily commit graph. - **Offline First**: All data remains on-device with optional encrypted iCloud/GDrive backup.
